name: rgenr8-longevity-data-lab
title: RGENR8 Longevity Data Lab
description: Open datasets on NMN (nicotinamide mononucleotide) from the RGENR8 Longevity Data Lab. Attribution required: credit "RGENR8 Longevity Data Lab" and link to https://rgenr8.com/research.

resources.name: nmn-human-trials
resources.title: NMN Human Trials Dataset
resources.description: Published human clinical trials of oral NMN, each checked against PubMed or the DOI record on 2026-10-10.

fields.name: id
fields.description: Stable row identifier (first author and year)

fields.name: title
fields.description: Article title as indexed in PubMed (or the publisher record)

fields.name: first_author
fields.description: First author surname and initials

fields.name: year
fields.description: Publication year of the journal issue

fields.name: journal
fields.description: Journal name

fields.name: doi
fields.description: Digital Object Identifier

fields.name: pmid
fields.description: PubMed ID (blank if not indexed in PubMed)

fields.name: country
fields.description: Country where the trial was run

fields.name: design
fields.description: Study design as reported

fields.name: randomised
fields.description: Yes, No or Not stated

fields.name: placebo_controlled
fields.description: Yes if any arm received placebo

fields.name: blinded
fields.description: Blinding as reported

fields.name: n_randomised
fields.description: Participants randomised (blank if not randomised or not reported)

fields.name: n_participants
fields.description: Participants enrolled, all arms including comparators

fields.name: population
fields.description: Who took part

fields.name: age_range
fields.description: Age range or summary as reported (eligibility range where stated)

fields.name: daily_dose_mg
fields.description: NMN dose arms in mg per day, separated by semicolons

fields.name: dose_min_mg
fields.description: Lowest NMN dose arm, mg per day

fields.name: dose_max_mg
fields.description: Highest NMN dose arm, mg per day

fields.name: duration_weeks
fields.description: Length of dosing in weeks (blank for single-dose studies; days divided by 7)

fields.name: duration_text
fields.description: Length of dosing as reported

fields.name: comparator
fields.description: What NMN was compared with

fields.name: primary_outcomes_measured
fields.description: Primary outcome(s) as stated by the authors

fields.name: authors_reported_result
fields.description: Neutral paraphrase of the authors' reported results, including null findings

fields.name: funding_or_conflicts
fields.description: Funding sources and conflicts of interest as stated in the paper or record

fields.name: registration
fields.description: Trial registry identifier(s) where reported

fields.name: route
fields.description: Route of administration

fields.name: verified_from
fields.description: Sources used to check the row

fields.name: pubmed_url
fields.description: PubMed link

fields.name: doi_url
fields.description: DOI link

fields.name: date_checked
fields.description: Date the row was checked (ISO 8601)

resources.name: nmn-price-index-2026
resources.title: The UK NMN Price Index 2026
resources.description: Standard prices of NMN products sold in the UK, checked 2026-10-10, with price per gram of NMN.
